newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: N.Korea to respond on talks proposal on April 16.
newsitem.headline: N.Korea to respond on talks proposal on April 16.

text.p: North Korea is expected to respond on April 16 to four-nation peace talks proposed by the United States and South Korea, a Seoul government official said on Wednesday.
The official, who asked not to be identified, said senior foreign ministry officials of the two Koreas and the United States were due to meet in New York next Wednesday.
"North Korea is expected to formally respond to the New York briefing last month by the United States and South Korea on the four-party talks," the official said.
The talks, which will also include China, are aimed at securing a peace treaty to replace the 1953 armistice that ended the three-year Korean War but left the two Koreas technically at war.
South Korea and the United States, which have tried to coax Pyongyang into the talks, have said they are considering more food aid to hunger-stricken North Korea.
North Korea's food crisis was underscored by news on Tuesday that the Stalinist state had told international aid agencies 134 children had died of malnutrition.
